title: 2015 AMC 8 Problem 18
statement: An arithmetic sequence is a sequence in which each term after the first is obtained by adding a constant to the previous term. For example, \(2,\) \(5,\) \(8,\) \(11,\) \(14\) is an arithmetic sequence with five terms, in which the first term is \(2\) and the constant \(3\) is added. Each row and each column in this \(5\times5\) array is an arithmetic sequence with five terms. What is the value of \(X?\)

solutions.text:
In any five-term arithmetic sequence, the middle term is the average of the first and last terms.

The middle entry of the top row is \(\dfrac{1+25}{2}=13,\) and the middle entry of the bottom row is \(\dfrac{17+81}{2}=49.\)

Now apply the same fact to the middle column: \(X=\dfrac{13+49}{2}=31.\)

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: In a five-term arithmetic sequence, the middle term is the average of the first and last terms.
Apply that fact to the top row, bottom row, and then the middle column.
